subject: Evidence sourcing: HelixBank FedRAMP / ISO intake and scope confirmation
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice@helixbank.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Evidence inventory request — HelixBank FedRAMP / ISO intake

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call earlier. As discussed, HelixBank’s compliance team needs an initial evidence intake to scope our upcoming FedRAMP authorization and ISO 27001 alignment. Can you provide the following by Dec 30 so our auditor can begin the mapping?

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (or interim attestation) and testing period dates
- ISO 27001 scope statement and any existing gap assessments
- CAIQ / SIG compressed response (latest completed)
- Network architecture diagram (prod region + peering/VPCs)
- KMS/HSM proofs (key ownership model, KMS vendor, rotation policy)
- Data flow diagram showing customer data paths and retention points
- App-level list of third-party dependencies and SBOM reference
- Penetration test summary and remediation evidence for high/critical findings
- Retention and deletion policy for logs and backups

Audit window: tentative Jan 10–Feb 28. Primary contact for intake is me (alice@helixbank.com) and their external auditor is SecureScan (securescan@auditcorp.com). We also need a point person at Redwood to coordinate samples and DocuSign evidence receipts.

Let me know if Dec 30 is realistic and who on your side will own each item. If you prefer, we can accept staged deliveries (high-risk items first).

Thanks,
Alice Turner
Head of Vendor Risk — HelixBank
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice@helixbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence inventory request — HelixBank FedRAMP / ISO intake

Hi Alice — great to meet you earlier.

Appreciate the list. Dec 30 is aggressive but doable if we prioritize the items you've flagged. Proposed intake plan:

1) Initial deliverables by Dec 30: SOC 2 report, CAIQ export, ISO scope draft, KMS summary, network diagram (high-level).
2) Follow-on (by Jan 14): SBOM references, pen-test summary + remediation evidence, retention policy documents.

I've attached a short intake template you can use to indicate preferred format and sample locations (helixbank_evidence_intake_template.xlsx). Can you confirm whether the scope is limited to our production cluster in us-east-1 or if HelixBank needs staging/integration environments included? Scope affects the amount of evidence for network and KMS.

Owners on our side (provisional):
- SOC 2 & CAIQ: Marissa Cole (compliance lead)
- ISO scope draft & evidence mapping: Markus Klein (this thread) + Sofia Ivanova (controls)
- KMS + infra diagrams: Aditya Rao (infra)

If you confirm scope today, we'll begin pulling artifacts and share a shared Drive link for secure upload. Also, if SecureScan needs direct access to any systems or logs, let us know the exact data pull requests so we can schedule.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: helixbank_evidence_intake_template.xlsx)
From: Alice Turner <alice@helixbank.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: SecureScan Audit Team <securescan@auditcorp.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence inventory request — HelixBank FedRAMP / ISO intake

Thanks Markus — confirming production-only scope (us-east-1) for the first pass. Staging can be added later if needed.

SecureScan clarified they only need read-only access to exported logs and sample artifacts; they will not request live credentials. They asked for the following clarifications:
- Preferred export formats (PDF for reports, CSV/JSON for logs, PNG/PDF for diagrams)
- If any evidence is maintained in a ticketing tool (Jira), a project export or summary is acceptable instead of individual tickets
- DocuSign: please mark artifacts with an owner and expected retention date so we can record receipt.

They also provided a quick intake form link (AuditCorp Intake: https://auditcorp.example/intake/HLX-894) for automated mapping — we'll fill after you confirm owners.

Forwarding previous note below for context.

On Mon, Dec 20, 2026 at 11:05 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alice — great to meet you earlier.
> 
> Appreciate the list. Dec 30 is aggressive but doable if we prioritize the items you've flagged....

Best,
Alice
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence sourcing: HelixBank FedRAMP / ISO intake and scope confirmation

Team — quick internal sync and owners following HelixBank’s confirmation (prod-only, us-east-1). Please treat dates as firm; HelixBank plans auditor mapping Jan 10.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Marissa: Export latest SOC 2 Type II report + CAIQ compressed response — deliver to shared Drive by 2026-12-28. (Attachment: redwood_soc2_2026Q3.pdf stub)
- Aditya: Network architecture diagram (annotated for customer data paths) + KMS summary (rotation/ownership) — deliver by 2026-12-29.
- Sofia: Draft ISO 27001 scope statement and control-mapping spreadsheet (map to CAIQ/SOC) — deliver by 2026-12-30.
- Markus: Curate pen-test summary and remediation evidence; coordinate SecureScan access requests — initial batch by 2027-01-14.

Upload instructions: place artifacts in the shared folder: drive.redwood.com/teams/compliance/helixbank-hlx-894 (I’ll create and invite HelixBank + SecureScan once artifacts are uploaded). Mark each file with a single-line metadata prefix in the filename: owner_initials_date (e.g., MC_20261228_soc2.pdf).

Risks / blockers: if any evidence is stored in customer-facing tickets, we need a short export from the ticketing project. Also, if any infra logs require redaction, note what fields need redaction so we can pre-process.

I’ll send a weekly cadence invite starting Dec 27 and a brief intake tracker so we can mark completed items.

Thanks — please reply with any scheduling conflicts.

— Markus
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
(Internal attachments referenced: redwood_iso_scope-draft.pdf, helixbank_evidence_intake_template.xlsx)
